22:05 UTC follow-up: the stale hidden lighting snapshots are now isolated and corrected in the consumer verification host. Standalone public JavaFX 24.0.1 reproduction: direct/nested SubScene red->blue PixelBuffer update snapshots are correct; a containing ScrollPane's default cached viewport holds the old red bitmap. setCache(false) on that viewport restores blue. Eight nesting/cache combinations reproduce/refute the hypothesis. This is a ScrollPane snapshot/cache interaction, not a failed native backend dispatch. App probe now disables that verification-host cache and checks actual captured cortical pixels; deliberate old-cache negative build is rejected.

Corrected real beta control/no-mipmap runs both pass eight state/geometry/pixel cases, 176105/176088 actual shading-change pixels, no visible stage. Root actually viewed both unlit framebuffers; grain remains with mipmaps disabled. Hence filtering-only patch is insufficient, and no renderer adoption is claimed. Source/reproduction/commands/logs/images/negative control are retained /Users/bbuchsbaum/code/scala/plsneuro/output/brain-display/hidden-13, with frozen runtime/experimental renderer provenance in hidden-12/evidence. Next native rendering work can use direct snapshots or uncached inspection hosts without window popups; test color interpolation on an analytical dense surface before further cortical optimization.
